response.sql: SELECT sites.insurstat, COUNT(scanconservation.cureregistry) as count, CAST(COUNT(scanconservation.cureregistry) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(scanconservation.cureregistry)) OVER () as share FROM scanconservation LEFT JOIN sites ON scanconservation.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry GROUP BY sites.insurstat ORDER BY sites.insurstat;

assumptions.assumption: Conservation records with zoneref values that do not match any site.zoneregistry are included in the result with NULL insurstat, forming their own group. This interpretation aligns with the request phrase 'missing status treated as its own group'.
